source_evidence: Many employers match contributions you make up to a certain amount. Consider contributing at least that amount so you can take full advantage of your employer’s matching funds so you don’t lose out on that free money.
question: Misconception: My workplace retirement plan gets the full employer match regardless of how much I contribute.
answer: Employer matching is typically tied to the contributions you make and may apply only up to a certain amount. The source suggests contributing at least enough to receive the full match, so contributing less could mean missing out on some matching funds.
